title: Did you lose your way?
description: A bilingual lesson in which Mrs. Mills loses her way in London, suddenly has an idea, and stops a German tourist at the bus stop. The tourist smiles pleasantly but cannot understand her, and reads the phrase 'I do not speak English' from his phrasebook. Mrs. Mills is sorry and says goodbye. Includes a fill-in text with 21 blanks, sentence-making with adverbs, and grammar on irregular past-tense verbs, completing a passage, 'Do/Does ... ever ...?' questions and short answers, and 'didn't ... but ... did' contrast sentences. 课文讲述米尔斯夫人在伦敦迷了路，忽然想出一个主意，在汽车站拦住一位德国游客问路。游客友好地微笑着，但听不懂她的话，于是从短语手册里念出"I do not speak English"。米尔斯夫人很抱歉，道了别。配合教材21空填空短文、副词造句练习，以及不规则动词过去式、短文填空、"Do/Does ... ever ...?"问句和简略回答、"didn't ... but ... did"对比句的语法练习。
answer_note: Lesson listening question answer is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (fill-in text) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 73 key (img/key-072-075.jpg). Practice B (join the pairs) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 73 key (img/key-072-075.jpg). Grammar I (irregular past tense) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 73 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 504-505). Grammar II (complete the passage) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 73 grammar key (PDF viewer page 504). Grammar III (Do/Does ... ever ...?) item 1.a and item 2.a are printed examples; the remaining items are taken from the supplied Lesson 73 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 504-505). Grammar IV (didn't ... but ... did) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-12 are taken from the supplied Lesson 73 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 504-505). No external sources were used. Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
Why did the man smile?
听录音，然后回答问题。那人为什么微笑？
lesson.translation: Listen then answer this question. Why did the man smile?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text:
Mrs. Mills was walking along a street in London,
suddenly she had an idea.
lines.translation: 米尔斯夫人在伦敦沿一条街走着，忽然她有了个主意。

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text:
She saw a man at the bus stop,
and she stopped him.
lines.translation: 她看见一个男人在汽车站，她就拦住了他。

lines.speaker: MRS. MILLS
lines.text: Is this a long way to King Street?
lines.translation: 米尔斯夫人：到金街还要走很远吗？

lines.speaker: MRS. MILLS
lines.text:
I'm sorry, but I don't understand you.
Are you English?
lines.translation: 米尔斯夫人：很抱歉，我不明白你的意思。你是英国人吗？

lines.speaker: MRS. MILLS
lines.translation: 米尔斯夫人：噢，原来如此！

lines.speaker: MAN
lines.text:
He took a small book out of his pocket
and read it slowly:
'I do not speak English.'
lines.translation: 那人从衣袋里拿出一本小书，慢慢地念着："我不懂英语。"

lines.speaker: MRS. MILLS
lines.text:
I'm sorry, I thought you were English.
Goodbye.
lines.translation: 米尔斯夫人：对不起，我原以为你是英国人。再见。

lesson.title: Before-listening question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Why did the man smile? 听录音，然后回答问题。那人为什么微笑？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue. 根据对话回答问题。
lesson.context: The man smiled because he was German and could not understand what Mrs. Mills was asking.

questions.prompt: Why did the man smile?
questions.answer: He smiled because he was German and did not understand what she was asking.

items.meaning: 令人高兴地, 友好地

items.title: I'm sorry, but I don't understand you.
items.text: 很抱歉，我不明白你的意思。这里的 and 连词表示"所以"，相当于 so。例如：I was tired, and I went to bed early.（我累了，所以我很早就上床睡觉了。）

items.title: said to herself
items.text: 她自言自语地说。to oneself 表示"对某人自己"。例如：He said to himself, 'I'll never do that again!'（他自言自语地说："我再也不那样做了！"）

lesson.text:
参考译文
米尔斯夫人在伦敦沿一条街走着，忽然她有了个主意。
她看见一个男人在汽车站，她就拦住了他。
米尔斯夫人：到金街还要走很远吗？
那人友好地微笑着。
米尔斯夫人：很抱歉，我不明白你的意思。你是英国人吗？
那人：不是，我是德国人。
米尔斯夫人：噢，原来如此！
那人从衣袋里拿出一本小书，慢慢地念着："我不懂英语。"
米尔斯夫人：对不起，我原以为你是英国人。再见。
